check_constraints.expression: ((tipo)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['texto_corto'::character varying, 'texto_largo'::character varying, 'markdown'::character varying, 'numero'::character varying, 'fecha'::character varying, 'seleccion_unica'::character varying, 'seleccion_multiple'::character varying, 'booleano'::character varying, 'repetible'::character varying, 'calculo'::character varying, 'referencia_maestra'::character varying])::text[]))
((tipo)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['grupo'::character varying, 'campos'::character varying, 'repetible'::character varying, 'narrativa'::character varying, 'flujo'::character varying])::text[]))

((estado)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['sin_iniciar'::character varying, 'borrador'::character varying, 'en_revision'::character varying, 'correccion_solicitada'::character varying, 'aprobado'::character varying])::text[]))

((accion)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['enviar'::character varying, 'solicitar_correccion'::character varying, 'reenviar'::character varying, 'aprobar'::character varying, 'reabrir'::character varying])::text[]))

((((accion)::text = 'enviar'::text) AND ((estado_origen)::text = 'borrador'::text) AND ((estado_destino)::text = 'en_revision'::text)) OR (((accion)::text = 'solicitar_correccion'::text) AND ((estado_origen)::text = 'en_revision'::text) AND ((estado_destino)::text = 'correccion_solicitada'::text)) OR (((accion)::text = 'reenviar'::text) AND ((estado_origen)::text = 'correccion_solicitada'::text) AND ((estado_destino)::text = 'en_revision'::text)) OR (((accion)::text = 'aprobar'::text) AND ((estado_origen)::text = 'en_revision'::text) AND ((estado_destino)::text = 'aprobado'::text)) OR (((accion)::text = 'reabrir'::text) AND ((estado_origen)::text = 'aprobado'::text) AND ((estado_destino)::text = 'correccion_solicitada'::text)))

((((estado)::text = 'completada'::text) AND (version_pasarela_ejecutada IS NOT NULL) AND (completado_en IS NOT NULL) AND (motivo_no_concluyente IS NULL) AND (codigo_error IS NULL) AND (mensaje_error IS NULL)) OR (((estado)::text = 'no_concluyente'::text) AND (completado_en IS NOT NULL) AND (motivo_no_concluyente IS NOT NULL) AND (codigo_error IS NULL) AND (mensaje_error IS NULL)) OR (((estado)::text = 'fallida'::text) AND (completado_en IS NOT NULL) AND (codigo_error IS NOT NULL) AND (mensaje_error IS NOT NULL) AND (motivo_no_concluyente IS NULL)) OR ((estado)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pendiente'::character varying, 'en_ejecucion'::character varying])::text[])))
((((estado)::text = 'completado'::text) AND (objeto_docx_id IS NOT NULL) AND (objeto_pdf_id IS NOT NULL) AND (completado_en IS NOT NULL)) OR ((estado)::text <> 'completado'::text))

((estado)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pendiente'::character varying, 'en_ejecucion'::character varying, 'completada'::character varying, 'no_concluyente'::character varying, 'fallida'::character varying])::text[]))

((((decision)::text = 'aplicada'::text) AND (contenido_antes IS NOT NULL) AND (contenido_despues IS NOT NULL) AND (version_bloqueo_origen IS NOT NULL) AND (version_bloqueo_resultado = (version_bloqueo_origen + 1))) OR (((decision)::text <> 'aplicada'::text) AND (contenido_antes IS NULL) AND (contenido_despues IS NULL) AND (version_bloqueo_origen IS NULL) AND (version_bloqueo_resultado IS NULL)))
